messages:
maria: Hey team — can we get a short snooze on the monitor model-router-p95-latency? It's flapping during the canary rollout. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/model-router/latency?orgId=1

maria: Seen a spike of p95 from ~120ms -> ~850ms for about 3m, but traces point to a KV cache miss wave during the canary. Want to snooze 20m while we finish the rollout.

alex: what's the exact alert definition / monitor link?

maria: Datadog monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/1234567
Query: `avg(last_5m):percentile(avg:last_lat_ms{env:prod,route:model-router},95) > 500`

jamal: can you suggest a snooze window and whether we should bump the threshold instead of muting?

maria: I propose: snooze/mute for 20m scoped to the canary traffic only (so prod non-canary remains alerting). No permanent threshold change. I'll add a note on the monitor.

lina: +1 from infra, but please scope the snooze so we don't blind ourselves to real regressions: scope = `env:prod AND tag:canary=true`.

maria: good call — will scope it to `canary:true`. applying the mute now.

pagerduty-bot: Action logged: Monitor 1234567 snoozed by maria for 20 minutes (scope: env:prod,tag:canary=true). Incident linking disabled.

alex: thanks. can you paste a trace id or a short snippet so we can confirm KV miss pattern?

maria: trace id: `01f2d4c9-3a9b-4fcd-bc8e-9a12abcd3456`
span summary: `model_router::serve` (200ms) -> `kv_lookup` (580ms) -> downstream fetch (30ms)

jamal: confirmed on our side — KV backend shows elevated p99 for that time window. I'll create a follow-up ticket to dig into batcher->kv latency. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-789

lina: add a reminder to unsnooze early if the monitor doesn't settle after the canary completes. thx :thumbsup:

maria: noted. I'll unmute earlier if it doesn't improve. :white_check_mark:

maria: quick ops note for the record: if anyone wants to see raw logs/traces for that trace id: 
- Traces: https://traces.redwood.com/trace/01f2d4c9-3a9b-4fcd-bc8e-9a12abcd3456
- Logs filter: https://logs.redwood.com/?q=trace_id:01f2d4c9-3a9b-4fcd-bc8e-9a12abcd3456

alex: thanks all, closing the loop here. will watch dashboards for the next 30m and ping if anything unexpected shows up.
_metadata_note: Thread contains short messages, a bot action, links to dashboards/monitors/ticket, and a scoped temporary snooze request per agents.md rules.
